provenance.source: openstudio-necb umbrella pipeline self-declaration — the compliance determination itself (Part 8 Section 8.4), which no domain gem can declare because it spans them. Article titles cross-checked against the building-codes MCP (necb:2025 Division B; 2020 uses the pre-renumbering 8.4.4 for the reference building).
provenance.note: This file carries ONLY article_coverage — the umbrella has no rule data of its own (verdicts and iteration logic live in compliance.rb; EUI arithmetic in tiers.rb reads eui_targets_2025.json).

articles.title: Determination of Compliance
articles.how: The pipeline computes the (2) annual-energy verdict (proposed vs reference building energy target), the (3)/(4) unmet-hours verdicts (with the vacuous-cooling determination when the proposed has no mechanical cooling), and the sentence-(5) capacity auto-iteration (global sizing-factor bumps with hard-sized-equipment stall detection) — compliance.rb; asserted by test_compliance.rb.

articles.title: Treatment of Process Loads
articles.how: (2): process loads included in the proposed model are automatically included in the reference — the reference is a clone and no transform touches process loads. (1) exclusion-by-default is the modeller's input decision.

articles.title: General
articles.how: Compliance is assessed through modeling: the umbrella is the only gem permitted to run EnergyPlus, and a determination requires sizing + annual runs of BOTH models (simulate: :annual); any other mode is flagged non-determining.

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.how: (2)/(3) annual 8760-h runs at hourly timestep for both models; a shortened run_period computes the arithmetic but flags NOT code-compliant. (4) software conformance rests on EnergyPlus's ANSI/ASHRAE 140 testing (see 8.4.2.11).
articles.gaps: (5) redundant/back-up equipment exclusion and (6) exceptional-calculation-method routing are modeller decisions, not automated; (1) end-use accounting covers what the model contains — elevators/escalators (j) are not added by the pipeline.

articles.title: Climatic Data
articles.how: Weather attach (CWEC EPW + DDY design days) via OpenStudioSimulation::Runner.attach_weather!; HDD resolution explicit arg -> Table C-1 -> .stat fallback (openstudio-envelope Climate).
articles.gaps: (2) choice among multiple urban climatic data sets is the modeller's; the pipeline attaches exactly the file it is given.

articles.title: General (Proposed Building)
articles.how: The proposed model is simulated as supplied — the pipeline applies no transforms to it (weather attach only); reference transforms operate on a clone. Guaranteed by test_caller_model_never_mutated (test_compliance.rb).
